name: Serious drug adverse event reports by active ingredient (openFDA FAERS)
description: Adverse event reports about drugs that reached the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) and are served by openFDA, received 2024Q3 to 2026Q2: 2,649,395 reports in all, 1,430,033 serious and 197,378 with a death outcome. One record per active ingredient for the 312 ingredients with the most reports plus every ingredient named in an open multidistrict litigation (31 of them tagged with their MDL numbers): reports that list the ingredient, how many were serious, how many reported a death outcome, the same counts for each of the last eight quarters, and the five most reported reactions. National, one shard. A report names a drug and an event; it does not show that the drug caused the event, and FAERS holds duplicates, follow-ups and reports from outside the United States.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Serious drug adverse event reports by active ingredient (openFDA FAERS) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963449
keywords: FDA adverse event reports by drug
mass tort drug injury market data

distribution.name: drug-events.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: drug-events.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: drug-events-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in drug-events-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to drug-events.csv on id.
